description: Upload the user's local usage to the public viberank.app leaderboard. Call it only when the user asked to submit. With a VIBERANK_TOKEN configured, the submission is verified and filed under the token's account, so leave github_username out. Without a token, github_username is required and must be the user's own GitHub handle, confirmed with them, because it becomes a public profile. Called without one, it uploads nothing and suggests a handle to confirm with the user before calling again. On success it returns rank, tier and a README badge you can offer to add.

github_username.description: The user's own GitHub username, as they confirmed it. Not a display name, not an organization. Leave it out when VIBERANK_TOKEN is set.

name: submit_to_viberank
